tagline: International Representation for Inland Navigation Interests
hero_kpi_rationale: Annual congress participation reflects member engagement and the organization's pan-European reach in the inland navigation sector. This indicator demonstrates the association's vitality and influence as a platform for international representation.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participation
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the IVR annual congress from various European countries.
kpis.description: The IVR hosted 225 participants from 11 European countries at its annual congress held May 15-17, 2024 in Frankfurt, reflecting its pan-European role in representing inland navigation interests.
kpis.signal: 225 participants from 11 countries at 2024 Frankfurt Congress

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participation
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural annual loss prevention colloquium organized by the IVR, bringing together professionals from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany.
kpis.description: Approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany gathered on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp for the first edition of the IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium, covering technical and financial aspects of prevention in European inland navigation.
kpis.signal: 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany at inaugural 2024 Antwerp Colloquium
